$comment: langchain-fireworks: `ChatFireworks(model=...)` sends OpenAI-compatible chat requests through the fireworks-ai SDK, to `https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions`, or to `/v1/chat/completions` under the `base_url` the code gives (the SDK drops `/inference` then); `FireworksEmbeddings(model=...)` posts to `/inference/v1/embeddings` on a base URL it fixes. The completions LLM `Fireworks` is `langchain-fireworks-llm.json`.
